Name: Decorator's Dream Furniture and Textures by Ilyeana  (With Functional Shelves)
Author: IlyeanaPlus
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/QbbURdH.png[/img]﻿

THIS MOD DOES A LOT OF STUFF. (Let me explain. No, there is too much. Let me sum up)
**All New items available in the Catalogue & Carpenter's Shop!

﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/trulHeS.png[/img]﻿﻿
[i](CP & Furniture Display Framework Required)
[/i][b][u]﻿All new shelves accept object placement!
[/u][/b]- 30+ New Options!!
- Variety of widths and heights with different object display sizes.
﻿-﻿ Custom elements to let you custom build  (left, center and right sections provided for 3 styles)
﻿- You can FINALLY do something cool above your sink!
-﻿ Colour Variations:
- 6 Common Woods plus Dark, Modern, Gold and Iridium Themes!
- 5 Wood variants inspired by DaisyNiko's Earthy Palette
- 3 variants to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1375]Kimberly's Kitchen Modpack[/url] (by request!)
- Other sets for other modpacks coming soon!﻿ 



[i]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/2vnAaiA.png[/img]﻿﻿
(CP & Furniture Display Framework Required)[/i]
[b][u] ﻿﻿All new wall arts accept object placement![/u][/b]
﻿-Scientific Posters, Boards, & Custom Frames
-﻿Custom Banners & Flags



﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/P55eytM.png[/img]﻿﻿
[i](Alternative Textures Required)[/i][i]
[/i] [b]﻿﻿[i]***KEYWORDS INCLUDED FOR EASY SEARCHING***
[/i][/b][i]- [/i]Jungle Decals: 192+
- Suit of Armor: 71+
- Stone Junimo: 14+
-﻿ Bear Statue: 36+
- Chicken Statue: 12+
- Gourmand: 5+
- Stone Frog: 14+
- Stone Owl: 10+ (Some pixel art obtained by permission - see below)
﻿[i]

[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gOxQRYk.png[/img]﻿﻿
[i]﻿(CP Required)[/i]
-Did someone say meow? There are cat statues! And goodest doggo bois! Surround yourself with lil guys or ﻿create a ﻿﻿memorial for a lost pet.



﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/kG5o95o.png[/img]﻿
﻿- No conflicts known at this time!! Works with BAGI / other object skin replacers.
﻿- Possible future conflict with other Furniture Display Framework dependents IF they add object placement to default items like tables.
﻿ ﻿(EX, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10884]Table Settings[/url] by aedenthorn). This is a planned feature that has not yet been added for this mod.




[img]https://i.imgur.com/doEfQqG.png[/img]﻿﻿
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]﻿Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]
[/url]-﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10855]Furniture Display Framework
[/url]﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]



﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/5CACakX.png[/img]
Happy Home Designer - ﻿
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13137]Catalogue Filter[/url]   - Save time by adding a search filter to the Catalogue!
-﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5176]Non-Destructive NPCs[/url]  - Go to the page just for the description! Then download it to protect ﻿your ﻿precious decorations.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/rRwDXe0.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿
- Add more colour variants to shelving and display items to coordinate with popular modpacks like LUTI and Rustic Country Interiors
- More retextures for vanilla game assets
- Add place settings for vanilla tables, so more than one item can be displayed
- At least one secret thing that I'm not telling anyone about yet!




﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/m3ECSRM.png[/img]﻿﻿
- ﻿#mod-making & #modded-farmers SDV Discord Channels for putting up with incessant questions and shenanigans at all hours of ﻿the day. And night. Wait where am I?
- ﻿Mod Authors that have come before! 
﻿﻿- Framework Authors: Pathoschild, aedenthorn, spacechase0, & Floogen. Thank you in particular for documentation! Your pages have been bookmarked, pinned, and referenced many times. ﻿ ﻿
﻿﻿- Pretty-Thing-Makers: Himetart, Wildflour, & Gweniaczek are largely responsible for inspiring me to ﻿make the Valley ﻿more aesthetic!
﻿﻿- ﻿BIG THANKS to Ankokou for allowing this mod to use his beautiful owl sprites from his[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936] scarecrow mod[/url]!
- Roq: for a million things and a million more.
